about: Verdicts of claude-opus-5-5 on source against tree for adg (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: Bold run-in names at the start of paragraphs are read as headings, so the paragraph text starts mid-sentence; the meaning still reads through the heading path.
findings.evidence: source: "Food Hygiene (England) Regulations 2006 (SI 2006/14 as amended)" / tree heading: "Food Hygiene (England) Regulations 2006", text: "(SI 2006/14 as amended)"

findings.problem: The fl ligature is dropped, so "flats" becomes "fats".
findings.evidence: source: "such as a block of flats" / tree: "such as a block of fats"

findings.problem: The fi ligature is dropped in several words.
findings.evidence: source: "sufficient", "fittings approach" / tree: "suffcient", "fttings approach"

findings.problem: The fl ligature is dropped in "reflected".
findings.evidence: source: "should be reflected" / tree: "should be refected"

findings.problem: The closing paragraph about buildings with more than one dwelling is joined to item e instead of standing on its own.
findings.evidence: "Where a building consists of more than one dwelling (such as a block of fats)"

findings.problem: The 'fi' ligature is dropped throughout the paragraphs, leaving misspelt words that still read.
findings.evidence: source: "fittings approach", "five days", "final certificate" / tree: "fttings approach", "fve days", "fnal certifcate"

findings.problem: The 'fi' and 'fl' ligatures are dropped, leaving misspelt words.
findings.evidence: source: "fittings approach", "self-certification", "reflect" / tree: "fttings approach", "self-certifcation", "refect"

findings.problem: The two columns of the worked example box are interleaved line by line, so the steps and figures of the calculation are mixed up.
findings.evidence: tree: "Therefore the maximum permitted length equates to 5.8m which, is less than the actual length of 7m therefore calculate The example below is for a G½"

findings.problem: The last words of the worked example's conclusion are split off and put in a separate box under Notes.
findings.evidence: source: "a 28mm (D2) copper pipe will be satisfactory." / tree: Notes box "be satisfactory."

findings.problem: In the table text the footnote under the table sits in the middle of the G1 rows instead of after them.
findings.evidence: tree: "G1 28mm 35mm Up to 9m 1.4m", "*see 3.51 and 3.58 and Diagram 1", "42mm Up to 18m 1.7m"

findings.problem: The 'fl' and 'fi' ligatures are dropped.
findings.evidence: source: "flow resistance", "fittings appropriate" / tree: "fow resistance", "fttings appropriate"

findings.problem: The 'fl' and 'fi' ligatures are dropped in paragraphs A8 and A9.
findings.evidence: source: "flow rates", "fitting", "figure", "benefit" / tree: "fow rates", "ftting", "fgure", "beneft"

findings.problem: In rows (5) to (11) the row number and label, printed in the second and later columns, are joined into the first column; the values 0.91 and 5.0 still sit in column (4) beside the right label.
findings.evidence: source: "(8) | Normalisation factor | 0.91" / tree: ["(8) Normalisation factor", "", "", "", "", "0.91"]

findings.problem: The heading 'Consumption from multiple fittings' is merged with provision A8 into one title.
findings.evidence: tree: "Consumption from multiple fittings A8"

findings.evidence: tree: "(f) Maximum fow rate (litres/min) Proportionate fow rate (litres/min) = [(f) × 0.7]"

findings.problem: The table text of A2.1 and A2.2 mixes rows from other tables on the page (for example dishwasher rows in the bath table); the grids are right.
findings.evidence: tree (A2.2 text): "Average litres per place setting = [(e)/(d)]"

findings.problem: The 'fi' and 'fl' ligatures are dropped in A10.
findings.evidence: source: "The figure", "flow rate/volume", "significantly" / tree: "The fgure", "fow rate/volume", "signifcantly"

findings.problem: The footnote under Table A2.7 that defines effective flushing volume for dual flush WCs is attached to Table A2.5, and Table A2.7 has no notes.

findings.problem: fi ligatures are dropped in A19.
findings.evidence: source: "fittings" / tree: "fttings"; source: "specified" / tree: "specifed"

findings.evidence: tree: "Average rainwater demand = [(f)/(e)] × 4.42 from WCs"

findings.problem: The subheading 'Rainwater saving calculations' above A27 is kept at the end of A26's text.
findings.evidence: tree: "to calculate the rainwater savings. Rainwater saving calculations"

findings.problem: The 'fi' ligature is dropped in several words, but they still read right.
findings.evidence: source: "defined", "specified", "self-certification" / tree: "defned", "specifed", "self-certifcation"

findings.problem: The Crown copyright imprint is joined onto the paragraph 2.11 amendment text as if it were part of the provision.
findings.evidence: tree: "...water efficiency calculator must be completed.” © Crown copyright, 2016 You may re-use this information..."

findings.problem: The first line of the page heading is lost, so the chapter and table title keep only the second half of the question.
findings.evidence: source: "Which version of the Approved Document applies to my project?" / tree: "applies to my project?"

findings.problem: The page number is kept at the end of the text.
findings.evidence: tree: "for copies purchased after ??? 2015. 12"

findings.evidence: source: "Paragraph 3.60 of the Approved Document says that if a discharge pipe is connected to a soil stack" / tree: "3 soil stack the discharge pipe"

findings.problem: Each multi-line question heading is split into several sibling headings, and the answer sits under only the last fragment, losing the question.
findings.evidence: source: "Is a combi boiler with a storage capacity of less than 15 litres therefore also not notifiable?" / tree heading_path: "litres therefore also not notifiable?"

findings.problem: The page number is kept as a text section.

findings.evidence: tree: "b. is started and is sufficiently progressed within the period of six months beginning on that day. Please note that ‘building notice’..."
